policy.IL_DIRECT_THROW: the accessor body itself executes throw or rethrow
policy.IL_REACHABLE_THROW: a throw is reachable from the accessor through calls that stay inside the registered assemblies; the chain is recorded
policy.IL_ABSTRACT_DECLARATION: an abstract or interface accessor declares no body, so it is fallible exactly when a registered implementor is
policy.IL_NO_FAILURE_PATH: no throw is reachable inside the registered assemblies; allocation, external calls and universal CLR failures such as OutOfMemoryException are not XNA contract behaviour
policy.ACCESSOR_ABSENT: the CLR property does not declare this accessor
policy.IL_ACCESSOR_NOT_FOUND: the contract declares an accessor the IL does not; a hard error
